title: Nightreach Observatory - Under the Whole Sky
_note: Option A anchor. gbc 4-voice band. town/reverent. Contemplative A minor resolving toward C major, 84 BPM, 4/4, 24 bars (~34s). Lonely spacious lead — long notes, wide intervals, lots of air. pulse12 slow arpeggiated pad-figure (broken chords slow enough to read as a pad) = Lunar dreamlight. Deep slow sustained tri_bass roots. Faint clockwork tick (dry hat on a steady subdivision, no kit groove). Vesper motif vast and arpeggiated: rising leap E4->A4->B4 unfolds slowly, the settle resolving from minor into major (C5...E5->D5->C5) at the loop's turn — hope dawning. Last bar G->C pickup voice-leads to bar 1 (E4 a-minor start).
